capabilities: markdown-notes | Stores linked Markdown pages in a private space, edited in a web interface with full-text search and Lua scripting, and kept as plain files.
description:
UnitySVC runs the official SilverBullet server image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. SilverBullet is a self-hosted note-taking and personal knowledge tool: pages are plain Markdown files that link to each other, you edit them in the browser, search them, and extend the space with Lua. This listing runs the slim image, without Chromium, so SilverBullet's optional Runtime API is not available. The server's settings, your pages and attachments are kept in the instance's data folder, stored in the `silverbullet` folder of your home, so they survive stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated sign-in name and password. A new instance starts in SilverBullet's one-time upgrade page, protected by that name and password: open `https://<instance>/.setup/migrate/`, sign in, tick the backup box and press Migrate, then sign in again to your space. Until you have done that, and afterwards, nobody can read or change anything without signing in. You can run one SilverBullet instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream SilverBullet documentation and the community forum for software-specific help.

features: Markdown pages with links, tags, search and a document picker
Lua scripting and plugs for extending the space
Accounts, spaces and API tokens managed in the Dashboard
Plain Markdown files, so your notes stay portable
Your data is kept in your home, across stops, restarts and re-enrollment

base.description: One private SilverBullet server; its configuration, pages and attachments are kept in the silverbullet folder of your home between runs and enrollments.

SB_PASSWORD.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own. It is the password for the one-time upgrade page of a new instance, and it becomes the administrator's password when you complete that upgrade. After that this value is ignored: change the password in SilverBullet's Dashboard. Save it now: the platform keeps it as a secret and does not show it again.
SB_PASSWORD.title: Sign-in password

SB_USERNAME.description: The administrator's user name. Like the password, it is used only for the first upgrade of an empty instance: if your data already exists (an earlier enrollment, or a restart) this value is ignored and the existing accounts still apply. It cannot contain a colon.
SB_USERNAME.title: Sign-in name
